server.py L1467-L1473 — CORS middleware allow_origins=* is fine for a public marketing site, but once production traffic is on a custom domain, tighten this via env var. `allow_credentials=True` + `allow_origins=['*']` is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers will refuse credentialed requests with wildcard origin) — user MUST set CORS_ORIGINS to their real domain(s) before switching auth cookies to that domain. rca_of_the_issue: ffmpeg is a system apt package, not a Python dependency. Container images sometimes drop it during rebuilds. The backend correctly detects this at pipeline-runtime (server.py L1020) and raises a clear RuntimeError. The fix is a single command: `apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-dejavu-core` and restart the backend supervisor. This will additionally give ffprobe (used at L949 for duration probing) and the DejaVu font family (used by ffmpeg drawtext filter in formats.py). No code changes required. Previous iterations reported ffmpeg was present — either the container was rebuilt without it or a cleanup script removed it since iter-10.
